label: Strengthened Kantian thesis: no reality feature is EXISTENCE_8 at the selected world
paraphrase: Rival, an analyst strengthening of Kant's thesis that being is not a real predicate (A598/B626, navigation; attribution deferred): no feature of the reality profile is had by exactly the candidates that exist at the selected world. It is the exact Lean negation of the EXISTENCE_8 premise, so it also denies accidental coextension, which Kant's intensional thesis (existence is no determination contained in a concept) does not deny. On Kant's positive account existence is the positing of a thing with its determinations, the instantiation sense EXISTENCE_1.
